goal: Prevent disconnecting well-behaved peers during initial block download when slow bandwidth delays pongs
Keeps nodes connected to peers actively sending blocks instead of timing out after 20 minutes
agreement: Strong support with all concerns addressed
Verified peer stays connected during block download under simulated bandwidth throttling (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Approvals after timeout edge-case questions and test updates were settled (danielabrozzoni, fjahr, maflcko)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents spurious disconnections of well-behaved peers during initial block download
Peers prioritize block transfers over pings, which previously caused slow downloaders to drop them needlessly
